meta.name: Gangs of Galicia
meta.description: When her father's murder reveals a hidden double life, a lawyer seeks revenge by infiltrating a Galician drug cartel and becoming close to its leader.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When her father is murdered, Ana moves to Galicia to lead her own investigation into his past. Soon she meets Daniel, the heir to a drug empire.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The Padíns want to keep young Marco out of their business. After making a deal with Daniel, Ana begins digging into his numerous shady enterprises.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Ana goes on a fancy business trip with Daniel and has a rocky encounter with José Padín. The relationship between Marco and María worries the clan.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Samuel's release heightens tensions and intensifies police investigations. Ana assists the clan's next operation while keeping her true plan in mind.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: José Padín is accidentally thrust back into the spotlight. A shooting disrupts the town and forces Ana to undertake a mission on Daniel's behalf.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While Daniel involves Ana in his future plans, Nazario pokes around the lawyer's past. The Padíns discover that there's a snitch among them.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: It's all set for the big operation. As secrets continue to unfold, Ana is thrown into turmoil in an attempt to warn Daniel before it's too late.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After four years in prison, Daniel returns to Cambados, where new rivals threaten his father's empire. Ana gets a chance to reclaim her life.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Back from abroad, Ana returns to Galicia on business. Daniel approaches his godson. The Padíns get into deep water during a highly anticipated drop.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Berta must confront a secret from her past. As Padín's suspicions grow, Nilo tries to sniff out a rat. Daniel takes a big risk by meeting his daughter.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Toño worms his way into the rival gang as the police make an arrest. A desperate Ana asks Daniel for help before receiving a call from the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Tensions rise as Paco and Padín struggle for control. Laura tries to help Ana on a risky mission, while Toño leads the clan — with police on their tail.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Marco takes to the stand and clan rivalries come to a head. Ana feels pressure to tell all, but her future with Daniel hinges on an impossible choice.
